conventions.Color: sRGB PNG RGBA, straight (not premultiplied) alpha; fully transparent pixels carry a constant fill colour
conventions.Normal: linear PNG RGB, OpenGL/Unity convention (+Y = green up), flat = (128,128,255)
conventions.MetallicSmoothness: linear PNG RGBA, R = metallic, A = smoothness (Unity Standard metallic workflow)
conventions.Cookie: grayscale PNG, white light on black, outer 3 px border exactly black
